scope: Pure model tests and real disposable PostgreSQL regex evaluation; no hosted writes

results.name: Unicode Arabic folding, diacritics, tatweel, whitespace and case normalize consistently
public and saved searches retain bilingual source names across display-language changes
category/city/region/partial matching composes with filters and never expands the saved subset
unreviewed/stale translation fields never become a public search index

generated Arabic server patterns execute in real PostgreSQL without unsafe interpolation
